standard_prerequisites.name: The defining properties of a projective cover: the map is essential and the source is projective
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used throughout the counted proof (source lines 645-652)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies projectivity and essentialness of the two covers.

core_obligations: Compare the covers: projectivity of the first cover and surjectivity of the second give a map between them over the module (proof lines 644-647)
The map is surjective because the second cover is essential (proof lines 648-649)
Split: the source of the first cover decomposes as the kernel of the comparison map direct sum the second cover, and the kernel vanishes because the first map is essential (proof lines 650-652)
proof_roadmap: P → M 与 P' → M 是两个投射覆盖；由 P 投射、P' → M 满，得与到 M 的映射相容的 α : P → P'。
因 P' → M 本质，α 满。
P' 投射 ⇒ P = Ker(α) ⊕ P'；再由 P → M 本质 ⇒ Ker(α) = 0。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a projective cover of a module, when it exists, is unique up to isomorphism (author lemma at source lines 638-642, label lemma-projective-cover-unique). The proof (source lines 644-653) compares two covers by a map over the module, shows it is surjective by essentialness, splits the source along it by projectivity and kills the kernel again by essentialness (proof lines 644-652). The splitting step is the substance. H3.
